notes.title: 3rd Anniversary & New Language Support: Korean, Greek, Slovak
notes.content:
Hello, it’s been a while!

In this update, the game is now available in three new languages.
A huge thank you to everyone who contributed their translations!

- Slovak translation – JediWithADragon
- Greek translation – teolev :3
- Korean translation – 후우

For more details on translations into other languages, please check the following thread:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2057080/discussions/0/3454842150488487381/

[hr][/hr]

Also, last month marked the 3rd anniversary since this game’s release.
It means a lot to us that so many people are still enjoying it today.

On Yuji Ninomiya’s YouTube channel, who is in charge of the game’s music and sound design, you can find live piano performances of the game’s music.
We hope you’ll take this opportunity to listen and enjoy.

[previewyoutube=jqMAx_vqcdU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Hungarian language is now supported! +Minor updates and release of our new games
notes.content:
With this new version, you can now play the game in Hungarian!
A big thank you to Numerolock for the translation! :)

Additionally, we have made the following updates:

- Fixed an issue where the language setting options did not switch correctly even after changing the language.
- Resolved a problem where the game would freeze when replacing, combining, or placing items in Vietnamese.
- Corrected the pitch of the sound effect for the [spoiler]empty glass[/spoiler].

[hr][/hr]

It's been about a year since the last announcement, and during that time, each of the two developers has released a new game. We hope you enjoy these as well.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1250630/Recolit/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2885880/_/

[hr][/hr]

For translations into other languages, please see the following thread
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2057080/discussions/0/3454842150488487381/

notes.title: Turkish and Polish is now supported!
notes.content:
From the new version, you can play the game in the following two languages!

- Turkish (localization by yamur <3)
- Polish (localization by Amitte Sukku)

Thank you very much for all the support!

Apology for the Polish localization

As for the item combination message and item name, it is very difficult to change the program, so we will use the same text even if the intended items are different. So we apologize for this.

notes.title: OST (Musics & Artworks) Released
notes.content:
Resonance of the Ocean - Musics & Artworks has been released today as a DLC.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42538250/e74a687d089b0ed5c6ee5e01340639a4f291e52f.jpg

This is a bundle of musics created by Yuji Ninomiya, composer and sound designer, and images that can be used for personal use, game streaming, and personal SNS accounts.

Musics included are as follows

- Title
- Stage Clear
- Main Theme (Ending)

Images included are as follows

- Key art
- Logo ( transparent )
- Field background (cropped)
- Player and some effects ( transparent )
- Rough design during production

Because the game itself is free, the price is a little high for the amount of content. We hope you enjoy it as an extra content.

notes.title: Update v1.2.4 and future updates
notes.content:
Once you have completed the game to the end, Start From "The Last Day" is now available in title menu. If you got achievements "The Last day" in previous versions, you can also use it.
 The volumes of some of SFX that was difficult to hear have been increased.


The following is a list of issues that we want to deal with, 
but we are still looking for a better way to do this, as it takes more time to implement and debug.


 Controller support
 Multi-language support


Due to the free game, we cannot spend much time on development and apologize for inconvenience.
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Update v.1.2.3
notes.content: The default language at launch is changed to English. It only starts up in Japanese when the system language is set to Japanese.
